comments.author: BhattaraiSijan
comments.body:
Thanks for the review @dzole0311, Addressed all comments in latest commit:

--Raw projection keys — extracted `globeproj, xmlpath, reszoomlevel, resunitsperpixel `into a new `RawMMGISProjectionConfiginterface` in `view.ts`.  `ProjectionOptions` extends `RawMMGISProjectionConfig` for now with a TODO to introduce a proper translation layer and remove the coupling.

--Hardcoded zoom levels — `_createCustomCRS` now accepts `maxZoom` and uses 
`projection.maxResolutionLevels ?? maxZoom ?? 20` as the resolution ladder bound.

--`invalidateSize()` on every `setView` — removed. The public `invalidateSize()`method remains for explicit use after container resizes.

--Noisy one-liner comments — removed
